creating: Your profile is being created. Sign out and in again if this stays.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.emptyBody: Titles you add, lists you create and sessions you watch will show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.verifyNote: Verify it to share lists and plans with friends.
settings.sent: Sent. Check your inbox and the spam folder.
settings.themeNote: Saved to your account, so your other devices follow. System matches this device.
settings.languageNote: Applies at once and is saved to your account.

push.label: Push notifications on this device
push.hint: Get a notice when a friend shares a list or plan with you or changes your access. Works even when Avleron is closed.
push.failed: Couldn’t change this. Check your connection and try again.

blocked.unsupported: This browser doesn’t support push notifications.
blocked.needs-install: On iPhone and iPad, add Avleron to the Home Screen first, then open it from there and turn this on.
blocked.unconfigured: Push notifications aren’t set up for this version of the app.
blocked.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser’s site settings, then come back.

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.hint: Copies your upcoming watch sessions (the next 90 days) to your Google Calendar. One way: changes made in Google Calendar don’t come back.
calendar.neverSynced: Not synced yet. Sessions appear in your calendar within a few seconds.
calendar.revoked: Access was revoked or has expired. Connect again to resume syncing.
calendar.failed: Couldn’t do that. Check your connection and try again.

result.connected: Google Calendar is connected. Your sessions are being copied.
result.denied: Access wasn’t granted. Allow Avleron to edit events when Google asks.
result.error: Couldn’t connect Google Calendar. Try again.

confirm.title: Disconnect Google Calendar?
confirm.text: The events Avleron added to your calendar will be removed. Your plans stay as they are.
